senses.gloss: f. (b. h.; = מקשאה, , v. קִשּׁוּאִים) cucumber field, in gen. truck-farm.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 1:4">Tosef. Ter. I, 4</cite>; Y. ib. I, 40ᵇ bot.

<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Metzia 9:32">Tosef. B. Mets. IX, 32</cite>; a. e. (v. also <cite ref="M00601"><he>מוּקְשֶׁה</he></cite>).—Pl. <cite ref="M02468"><he>מִקְשָׁאוֹת</he></cite>, <cite ref="M02468"><he>מִקְשָׁיוֹת</he></cite>, <cite ref="M02468"><he>מִקְשָׁאִין</he></cite>.
Shebi. II, 1 ליטע במ׳ (Ms. M. מקשות, corr. acc.; Maim. מקשיות), v. מִדְלַעַת.—In gen. מ׳ ומדלעות late vegetables or fruits.

<cite ref="Eruvin 104a">Erub. 104ᵃ</cite> <he>מִקְשָׁאָיו ומִדְלָעָיו</he> ed. Sonc.
